summary: Fix a pool lab defect found during the immutable rollout work: executing a fence-profile command rewrote the PoolCommand shared with the agent journal, so the next replay of the same operation looked like a reused ID with different input and stopped the agent. ExecutePoolFenceProfile now works on a copy. Also assessed: internal/vmhost/pool_quorum.go gains ExpectedVotes, TotalVotes and Quorum (votequorum's own counts, read from the same corosync-quorumtool output) for the rollout quorum gate, and internal/agent/pool_update_transport_test.go covers the live peer transport. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: No operator step changes; the fix removes an agent stop after a fence profile was recorded.

api.reason: No route or wire field changed. PoolQuorum gains the optional JSON fields expected_votes, total_votes and quorum, which are on-host quorum observations used by the rollout gate and are not part of a published route schema.

roadmap.reason: A defect fix inside the existing pool feature; no milestone changes.

state.reason: Core owns the agent command journal and the fence profile; the Controller only replays the command.
state.record: The agent's journal entry for the operation, which is now left exactly as received.

verification.method: TestRecordingAManagementControllerLeavesTheJournaledCommandUntouched passes (go test ./internal/agent -run ...). The failing-before run was not repeated; the defect was observed in the three-host lab.
